The Adjustment Factors shall be applicable at peak, shoulder and off peak time of use periods.
The Adjustment Factors and the Resultant Retail Tariffs are determined taking into account the cost allocation across the different customer categories. The detailed Tariff Order Paper is available at www.era.or.ug.
This Schedule of Tariffs for the Fourth Quarter of 2016 shall be applicable to all consumer bills raised based on meter readings taken in the period October 2016 to December 2016.
